reason: Lead source review requests a narrow actual owned native-child exit after preparation while the trusted owner and registry remain. No production transport edit is approved in this checkpoint.

cases.expected: An owned authored native child is confirmed nonlive outside Core after proof preparation while its relay is stopped/alive and cached owner/registry remain. Core consumption must refuse with zero worker_started/provider confirmation. A cached relay/kill(pid,0) check cannot substitute for generation-bound native-child liveness.

method: Freeze source and one exact local process control; stop only the created owned process group. No actual native account/status/thread/model call. Preserve a failure as a new dependency and return the checkpoint before any transport implementation.
lock_coverage: PinnedModelGuard.check_current holds its RLock only while reading protected metadata and sticky state. It releases the lock before RuntimeProofs returns Evidence and before Core changes attempt/task/event/outbox state. It does not serialize the entire admission or external cache writers.
